observable_defensive_events: caused turnovers (BOX SCORE only -- no event carries a causing defender), ground balls, penalties committed, goalie saves
defender_actions_completely_absent_from_: matchup/assignment; slides, recoveries and help; shot suppression and forcing a bad shot rather than a turnover; off-ball positioning; communication; and -- decisively -- minutes, shifts and lineups, so there is no exposure denominator for any defender at all
consequence: defensive_value_partial_raw is caused turnovers above the position group's per-GAME average. Its denominator is games played, so a defender who plays every defensive possession and one who rotates are treated as equally exposed. A value of 0.0 does not mean 'an average defender'; it means 'caused turnovers at his group's per-game rate, and everything else unmeasured'.
